contract_name: Accenture Decision Intelligence Persona Adaptation Contract
governance_rule: Identical quantitative ground truth and evidence IDs; persona-adapted narrative depth, framing, and actionable focus.

EXECUTIVE.target_audience: C-Suite, VP Commercial, Business Unit GM
EXECUTIVE.narrative_style: Concise, strategic, high-level impact and decision rights
emphasis: Gross revenue risk ($) and baseline deviation
Executive decision owner and required approval rights
Strategic remediation impact and next steps
EXECUTIVE.action_focus: Strategic budget reallocation and executive remediation sign-off

DOMAIN_ANALYST.target_audience: Commercial Finance Analyst, Marketing Operations, Supply Chain Specialist
DOMAIN_ANALYST.narrative_style: Deep statistical, granular telemetry mechanics, candidate arbitration breakdown
emphasis: 3-month baseline mean, standard deviation, and statistical z-score
Conversion and CTR formula components (e.g. conversions/clicks breakdown)
Candidate driver arbitration scores, contradiction counts, and alternative rejections
Raw SQL lineage partitions and cross-table join keys
DOMAIN_ANALYST.action_focus: Root-cause campaign inspection, landing page bounce audits, and tactical channel telemetry
